# Paths in ai-hero/wayfare-skills that auto-approve never approves; a person
# must. Each one either ships to every consumer on merge or runs on every
# plugin user's machine without being asked.
#
# auto-approve.yaml reads this file from main, never from the PR it judges,
# so a PR cannot shorten the list that judges it. That is also why the file
# lists itself.
#
# One bash glob per line; `*` matches across `/`. Blank lines and lines
# starting with `#` are ignored. A list with no entries fails closed.

# The reusable workflow ~25 repos run at @main, and the caller every
# consumer's copy is held to byte for byte.
.github/workflows/auto-approve.yaml
assets/auto-approve/caller.yaml
.github/auto-approve-human-review.txt

# Hooks run in every session of everyone with the plugin enabled, and the
# Stop hook sources hero-lib.sh.
hooks/*
scripts/hero-lib.sh

# Manifests decide what installs and can register more hooks or MCP servers.
.claude-plugin/*
.agents/plugins/*
plugin.json
.mcp.json
